Docket 1.3.123

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A first audit finishes about ten seconds sooner.* Topic suggestions ask Google's public autocomplete about what
  your site covers, a few dozen short questions with a pause between each. They used to run before Docket checked
  your pages in a browser; now the two run at the same time. On our own site the first audit went from 57 seconds
  to 44. Docket asks exactly the same questions, and if the suggestions cannot be fetched in time, the report says
  so and finishes without them.

99 checks across 13 areas.
